description: Expander for MIX 4, MIX 4 STEREO, VCA MIX 4 and VCA MIX 4 STEREO, muting numbered channels or the whole mix; it goes to the right of the mix module, in the chain of expanders there

params.text: Mutes that numbered channel while the button glows bright red; a lit button on a MIX SOLO expander overrides it
Mutes the final mix while the button glows bright red

inputs.text: Mutes that numbered channel when the voltage rises to 1V or more, and unmutes it when the voltage falls to 0.1V or less
Mutes the final mix when the voltage rises to 1V or more, and unmutes it when the voltage falls to 0.1V or less

notes: a button press always toggles the mute state, so it overrides what the CV input has set
one mute expander can be used per mix module, and it must be adjacent to a MIX SOLO expander if one is used
the indicator lamp glows yellow once the expander has connected to a mix module
menu: Mute/Solo CV toggles on/off, on the mix module's menu — makes the CV inputs flip the mute on each rising edge instead of acting as gates
Soft mute/solo, on the mix module's menu — on by default, slewing each mute transition over 25ms; switch it off for an immediate cut
